family.schneider-eurosx.description: The 386SX desktops in the Euro range.
family.schneider-eurosx.history: In 1991 it was advertised in Portugal as an affordable route into 32-bit computing. By May 1992, the EuroSX appeared alongside the Euro486 and the Desktop 386 and 486, with two separately named configurations. The December 1991 German list offered the 16 MHz EuroSX without a hard disk for network use at DM 1,841 net.
